name: To Whom the Bouquet Falls
source:
In the cozy seaside city-state of Parima, Tietra Hale has just finished her run as her cousin's bridesmaid. What a bouquet toss and the winds of change dictate for her isn't quite what she expected, but it's as just as much a surprise for the girl she meets...

[From [url=https://sirius-verre.itch.io/to-whom-the-bouquet-falls-prototype]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在舒适的海滨城邦帕里马，蒂特拉·黑尔刚刚结束了她表弟伴娘的旅程。花束的抛掷和变化之风对她来说并不完全是她所期望的，但这对她遇到的女孩来说同样是一个惊喜……

[来自[url=https://sirius-verre.itch.io/to-whom-the-bouquet-falls-prototype]itch.io[/url]]
